verdict.rationale: Quo documents its own event-driven call handling: routing incoming calls, custom ring orders, call transfers, phone menus, and Sona answering when the team can't. These are configurable behaviors triggered by inbound calls, so they count as a narrow form of rules triggering actions. There is no evidence of a general rule or workflow builder, webhooks, or triggers on other events such as messages or contacts. missing for 10: a general user-defined event→action rule engine, triggers beyond inbound call routing, action types beyond call handling, outbound webhooks or event subscriptions, and hands-on corroboration.
